editorial.marketOverview: Friday's technology weakness persists. Reuters reports the Nasdaq-100 down about 2%, SOX 5.1%, and Nvidia-linked CoreWeave and Nebius nearly 9% each. These are intraday, unsynchronized observations, not closing returns. IBD separately reported Nasdaq down about 1.3% and the 10-year yield around 5.14% during afternoon coverage.
editorial.whatChanged: The latest Reuters coverage adds a financing-contagion angle: investors are concerned about Nvidia-linked vendor guarantees and neocloud funding. The previously documented chip rout and negative breadth already established the bearish outlook; the new report reinforces it rather than proving another material shift. Open Watch remains at 163 events, updated 2026-11-13T18:24:41+00:00.
editorial.marketInterpretation: The initial rally after slightly softer monthly PPI failed to hold, while annual PPI of 6.5% and elevated yields keep valuation sensitivity high. Broad AI-infrastructure weakness suggests risk reduction beyond one chipmaker, but the exact causal contribution of financing concerns is not independently established. The prior 10Y-2Y spread of +29.1bp is stale, not a live rates confirmation.
editorial.threeDayPath: Friday November 13 remains exposed to a weak semiconductor-led close. Monday November 16 is the key continuation versus oversold-bounce test, particularly for SOX, QQQ, breadth and financing-sensitive neoclouds. Tuesday November 17 carries further AI earnings and Fed repricing risk. Bearish elevated downside remains the base case, with a sharp tactical rebound possible.
editorial.bullCase: Softer monthly PPI and isolated large-cap resilience could support recovery if QQQ and SOX turn together, breadth improves and yields and volatility ease at aligned timestamps. A temporary bounce without confirmation would not invalidate the bearish case.
editorial.bearCase: The semiconductor selloff and neocloud weakness indicate a broader reassessment of AI capex and financing. Friday weakness followed by Monday breaks below Friday lows would favor continuation, especially if rates remain high and breadth deteriorates.
editorial.watchNext: Confirm Friday closes in QQQ, Nasdaq, SOX, Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom and neoclouds; refresh synchronized breadth, VXN/VIX, 10Y/2Y, oil and CME FedWatch. Independently verify Nvidia earnings and Anthropic IPO timing. Recheck Open Watch for newly confirmed catalysts.
